plugins.name: Rooster One
plugins.author: Oxford Metadata Ltd
plugins.short_description: SEO, recommendations, pricing, pixels, couriers, feeds, wishlist, AI chat: 581 tools replacing dozens of plugins. One to load, and they agree.
plugins.description:
One plugin instead of dozens. 581 tools, and they agree with each other.

Rooster One does the work that would otherwise take dozens of separate plugins, and it does it from one place, on one set of numbers.

Dozens of plugins means dozens of different vendors, dozens of renewal dates to keep track of, dozens of update cycles that have to keep working alongside each other, and a different support desk to write to depending on which part has gone wrong. One plugin means one licence, one update, one place to ask, and one thing for WordPress to load on every request instead of dozens.

What is actually in it: a full SEO engine that can take over from Yoast or AIOSEO, importing what they hold first. Product recommendations built from your real sales. Role, wholesale and tiered pricing. Meta, Google Ads, GA4 and TikTok measurement, sent server-side so an ad blocker cannot silence it. Sixteen couriers with vouchers, labels, tracking and daily closings. Marketplace feeds and order import for Skroutz, Shopflix, eMAG, Etsy, Amazon and more. Side cart, wishlist, back-in-stock waitlist, quote requests for catalogue shops, swatches, trust badges. Popups and scheduled announcements. Abandoned-cart recovery, email and web push campaigns, audiences. Surveys, competitions and events. Invoices, packing slips and credit notes. A GDPR consent banner with a cookie scanner. The EU withdrawal button that Directive 2023/2673 now requires. And an AI assistant that answers from your own catalogue rather than making things up.

That is 581 tools, and there is a written description of what every one of them is for. All Features prints the figure for your own install, which is the only one that is true for you: how many pages you see depends on which modules apply to your shop.

Why one plugin rather than dozens

Because separate plugins cannot see what the others know, so they disagree, and each one works the same thing out again while your customer waits.

Rooster One measures your whole business on a schedule instead: every product, page, customer, order and session, written into flat tables. Which products sell and which never do, which pages are read, who bought and who nearly did. The SEO engine, the recommendations, the audiences, the ad ROI report and the AI assistant then all read those same tables. That is why they agree, and why the plugin gets faster to use as you switch more of it on: the heavy work already happened, before the request arrived. The trade-off is timing and we would rather say so plainly. A figure is only as new as its last run.

And it is one plugin to load, not dozens

This part has nothing to do with how well any plugin is written. WordPress loads every active plugin on every request, before it knows whether that request needs it: a file to read from disk, hooks to register, options to fetch, a translation catalogue to load. That toll is paid on the home page, on every admin screen and on every REST call, by every plugin, including the ones that will do nothing at all on that particular request. A site carrying a hundred of them pays it a hundred times before a single line of useful work happens.

Rooster One is one plugin, and the parts you have not switched on register nothing. On Pro, the storefront is served by a separate lightweight runtime rather than the admin half, so your customer’s page load carries the code that draws the page and not the code that runs the shop.

Everything is off by default. It installs beside your current SEO plugin, pixel manager and consent tool and changes nothing until you switch a piece on.

Rooster One runs on your own server. Everything it ever sends to an outside service, and what triggers it, is listed under “What does Rooster One send to an outside service, and when?” in the FAQ below.

The free version is a complete product, not a demo: 775 of the 1,302 screens, tools and actions are in it. Pro adds the operational half and the separate front-end runtime plugin.

Who builds it

Rooster One is built by Oxford Metadata Ltd, whose organisation is approved under Anthropic’s Cyber Verification Program for dual-use security work such as penetration testing and vulnerability research. That is the same discipline the plugin’s own defensive features come out of: the bot filtering, the form captcha, the consent and proof-of-consent log, and the login hardening. The AI features run on Anthropic Claude for chat and reasoning and Voyage AI for embeddings.

It reads your site for what it is

  • Shop — sales and add-to-carts are the measure.
  • Catalogue — products published but not sold; engagement is the measure.
  • Content — no WooCommerce; visits, engagement and forms are the measure.

Auto-detected, overridable in one click. Scoring, cornerstones and applicable signals all follow from it.

You can find all of it

Ctrl+K reaches every page and each of the 581 tools inside them, openable directly. All Features lists every one, with pinnable favourites, and prints the figure for your own install, which is the number that matters: the page count depends on which modules apply to your shop, so it differs between two shops running the same version. Every page carries a written description of what you can do there, and that text feeds the search.

What gets measured

Computed on a schedule, stored flat. Everything below reads these.

  • Product vitals — velocity, out-of-stock history, price history, basket role, returns, and a 0–100 demand score.
  • Content vitals — reach, engagement, freshness and a content-demand score for every post, page and custom type.
  • Customer vitals — an omnichannel profile: purchases, affinities, lifecycle stage, survey answers, return risk.
  • Session and attribution rollups — engagement joined to conversion on one session id, with landing page, campaign and five UTMs.
  • Effective prices — every price rule resolved ahead of time into one row per product per audience.

The features

AI chat & semantic search

  • Chat widget on Anthropic Claude, grounded in your catalogue — only real, in-stock items with exact links.
  • Semantic search on Voyage AI embeddings across products, posts, pages and terms.
  • A knowledge base you control, with identity guardrails so it cannot mis-describe you.
  • Chat analytics — what was asked, how it was rated, which questions found nothing, which chats ended in an order.
  • Related content on articles, guides, listings and products, from the same index. Added automatically to the content types you choose, or placed by hand with the AIEO Related content block or the [aieo_semantic_related] shortcode; either can be narrowed to one kind of content, so a listing recommends listings rather than products.

SEO engine

Imports from, and can take over from, AIOSEO, Yoast or Rank Math. Stays gated behind your current SEO plugin until you decide to switch over; a read-only importer for all three and a head-parity check are included.

  • Head, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD, assembled once into a cache.
  • Commerce schema from the same tables — ProductGroup + hasVariant, per-variant colour, gtin, brand, shipping and return policy.
  • AI titles and descriptions written against the live SERP. Drafts await approval, or run on Autopilot.
  • Opportunity grid — traffic × conversion: hidden gem, intent mismatch, defend, prune.
  • Rank tracking (optional DataForSEO, under your spend cap).
  • Redirects and 404s, slug monitor, static sitemap, robots.txt, alt-text filling, EU Omnibus history, hreflang, Local SEO.

Selling more

  • Recommendations — up-sell, cross-sell and same-need alternatives from your real sales patterns.
  • Rails you order by drag-and-drop, block and classic themes, with custom slots.
  • Pricing engine — role and wholesale prices, brand discounts, loyalty tiers, points, free gifts. Stacked, resolved ahead of time.
  • Merchandising — swatches, labels, trust badges, payment logos, galleries, layout builder, custom tabs, one master button style.
  • Lift measurement — the incremental orders and revenue the engine adds.

Cart, checkout, recovery

  • Side cart, sticky add-to-cart, wishlist, back-in-stock waitlist.
  • Quote requests for catalogue shops — an ask-for-a-price card on products you do not sell online, a quote basket the shopper grows as they browse, and the browsing trail behind each request. Booked as valued leads per campaign, so a catalogue stops scoring EUR 0.00.
  • Saved and abandoned carts — share and resume, cookieless restore that survives CDN caching.
  • Checkout tuning — distraction-free checkout with A/B assignment, minimum order, and business-invoice fields.
  • Full block and classic parity.

Reaching customers

  • Audiences — top, lapsed, lookalike, abandoned-cart, reactivation, competition entrants. Recomputed nightly.
  • Automated campaigns — abandoned cart, win-back, birthday, back in stock, post-purchase. Email and web push, quiet hours honoured.
  • Social posts from your catalogue, competitions on any Gravity Form, surveys scored into NPS and voice-of-customer.

Knowing what worked

  • Server-side measurement you own — Meta CAPI, GA4, Google Ads Enhanced Conversions, TikTok Events API. Deduplicated, sent after the order is saved, with a daily safety net.
  • Consent / GDPR CMP — first-party banner, Consent Mode v2, proof-of-consent log, cookie scanner.
  • ROI Wizard — orders, revenue, cost, net, ROAS and ROI by engine, offer, channel, campaign or creative.
  • Ad spend typed, by CSV, or nightly from Google Ads / Meta / TikTok. Conversion goals for non-shops.
  • Insights Chat — ask your shop questions in wp-admin. Customers pseudonymised, no data export.

Running the shop

  • Marketplace order import — Skroutz, Shopflix, eMAG, eFood, Wolt, Etsy, Amazon → native WooCommerce orders. The catalogue importer runs it in reverse: import products from a marketplace listing in one click.
  • Streaming feeds — ready-made templates for Amazon Inventory Loader, BestPrice, eBay File Exchange, eFood, EMAG, Etsy, Facebook Product Catalog, Facebook Marketplace, Google Shopping, Google Local, Google AdWords Custom Remarketing, Shopflix, Skroutz, Tolstoy and Wolt, plus Generic CSV and a fully custom builder.
  • Sixteen couriers — vouchers, labels, COD, tracking, bulk printing, daily closings. ACS, BOX NOW, Courier Center, ELTA, Geniki Taxydromiki, Speedex, DHL Express, FedEx, UPS, USPS, Royal Mail, DHL Paket, Colissimo, BRT, Correos Express, Sendcloud — plus a manual carrier for one with no API.
  • Order documents — invoices, packing slips, proformas, credit notes. Singly or merged across a date range.
  • Delivery economics — real break-even free shipping from your carrier costs, per-carrier × zone P&L.
  • Operational intelligence — stock recovery, missing hot sellers, out-of-stock predictor, branch stock, barcode scanning, optional ERP.

The withdrawal button — Directive (EU) 2023/2673

Every EU distance seller must now give consumers a prominent, permanently available button to declare withdrawal electronically. No transition period.

  • A real button, for the whole statutory period.
  • 14 calendar days from receipt — computed from delivery, not the order date.
  • Guests included. An account is offered afterwards, never required.
  • No reason, no prior contact, partial withdrawal by item and quantity.
  • Acknowledgement on a durable medium with content, date and time.
  • Cancellation stays distinct from withdrawal — one you may refuse, the other you may not.
  • Return vouchers checked by an operator before the customer sees them. Ships disabled.

Content, blocks and regional selling

  • Events with RSVP and self-registration, FAQ accordions, Store Pages, Food & Beverages option groups, Google reviews, Media Cleanup that quarantines before it deletes.
  • Dozens of server-rendered blocks — store, product, recommendation, swatch, brand, category, blog, competition and event, plus Custom Slot regions.
  • Regional checkout — COD by country or courier, “from X,XX €” labels before a postcode is entered, and per-country payment and shipping rules.

Speed and resilience

  • Pre-computed into flat tables; the storefront reads single cached rows.
  • A thin front-end runtime plugin (Pro) serves the storefront even when the admin plugin is trimmed from the request.
  • Self-healing jobs re-arm after updates, stay dormant until used, and collapse runaway third-party tasks.
  • Tables are never dropped on update, activation or deactivation — only on explicit uninstall.

Free and Pro

GPLv3. The free version is a complete, working product — not a demo with the useful parts removed.

GPLv3 throughout. There are three separate things here, and it is worth being precise about which is which, because two of them are called “Pro”.

1. This plugin, free. A complete, working product, not a demo with the useful parts removed: AI chat and semantic search, the whole SEO engine, pricing and merchandising, storefront features, measurement and consent, product feeds and marketplace feed export, courier fulfilment across all sixteen carriers, the block library, Ctrl+K — and the complete withdrawal button. That last is a legal obligation for every EU distance seller; charging for it would be a poor thing to do.

2. A Pro subscription (or the 14-day trial), activated by connecting the site to your Rooster One account. No per-feature keys. It unlocks the Pro screens whose code is already inside this download:

  • Marketplace order import — Skroutz, Shopflix, eMAG, eFood, Wolt, Etsy, Amazon.
  • Attribution and ROI — dashboard, ROI Wizard, ad-spend connectors, shipping cost against margin.
  • Audiences and campaigns — audience builder, email and web-push flows, social posts, AI-suggested offers.
  • Customer intelligence — customer lookup, surveys, cancellations and returns analysis, chat analytics.
  • Insights Chat, events and competitions, Action Scheduler cleanup.

3. Two companion plugins, included with a Pro subscription and installed separately. A subscription on its own does not put their code on your server, so these screens ask you to install the plugin rather than pretending to work:

  • Rooster One Runtime — serves the storefront, SEO head, sitemap and redirects without loading the admin half. The biggest single speed difference between free and Pro.
  • Rooster One Pro — carries seven engines this download does not contain: supplier invoice scanning, the accounting and ERP connectors (Entersoft, Galaxy, Soft1, Zoho Books, and Oxygen supplier sync), the catalogue importer for building a product source from a supplier feed, the product exchanger for sharing content between WP sites, the duplicate-product merge engine that auto detects simple products and converts them to variations, semantic internal linking, and the branch stock scanner for counting stock on the shop floor from a phone.

Everything Pro-locked stays visible with an explanation of what it does, and where a screen also needs the Pro plugin it says so before you buy, not after.

Optional integrations

Rooster One runs entirely on your own server. Nothing below is required for the plugin to work — each is an opt-in add-on you enable only if you want that capability, using your own account.

  • Rooster AI credits (rooster.systems) — powers the AI chat, AI SEO copy and Insights Chat via Anthropic Claude and Voyage AI embeddings, with no per-provider API keys to manage.
  • Recommendations service (eshop-optimizer.com) — graph-database up-sell/cross-sell analysis of your order history.
  • DataForSEO — optional keyword rank tracking under a spend cap you set.
  • Ad and measurement platforms …

plugins.name: RaCar Checkout Manager for Brazilian Stores
plugins.author: Rafa Carvalhido
plugins.short_description: Adds brazil's input fields to checkout & more. Plugin p/ lojas brasileiras com CPF, CNPJ e outros campos ao checkout, auto-preenchimento de endereços.
plugins.description:
RaCar Checkout Manager for Brazilian Stores is a powerful WooCommerce plugin designed specifically for Brazilian stores. It enhances the WooCommerce checkout experience by adding essential fields like CPF, CNPJ, RG, and more and allowing control of all WooCommerce fields. Additionally, it includes an address autofill feature that uses CEP (Brazilian postal codes) to automatically populate address fields, saving time and improving accuracy.

O Gerenciador de Checkout RaCar para Lojas Brasileiras é um poderoso plugin para WooCommerce desenvolvido especificamente para lojas no Brasil. Ele aprimora a experiência de finalização de compra no WooCommerce, adicionando campos essenciais como CPF, CNPJ, RG e outros, além de permitir o controle de todos os campos do WooCommerce. Adicionalmente, inclui um recurso de preenchimento automático de endereços que utiliza o CEP para preencher automaticamente os campos de endereço e bloquenado-os (à escolha do admin), economizando tempo e aumentando a precisão.

Key Features:

  • CPF, CNPJ, and RG Fields: Add and validate these essential fields for Brazilian customers.
  • Address Autofill: Automatically fill in address fields based on the CEP entered by the customer.
  • Customizable Checkout Fields: Enable, disable, or customize checkout fields to suit your store’s needs.
  • Input Masks: Add input masks for CPF, CNPJ, and cellphone fields for better user experience.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatibility: Fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Admin Interface: Modern and intuitive admin interface for managing settings.
  • Translation Ready: Fully localized and ready for translation.

This plugin is free and always will be. If it saves you time, consider buying me a coffee to support its development.

  • Campos CPF, RG, CNPJ, IE, número da residência, bairro e telefone: Adiciona e valida esses campos essenciais para clientes brasileiros.
  • Preenchimento automático de endereço: Preenche automaticamente os campos de endereço com base no CEP inserido pelo cliente.
  • Bloqueio de campos de endereço: Ao preencher os campos de endereço, pode bloqueá-los ao comando do admin.
  • Campos do checkout personalizáveis: Habilite, desabilite ou personalize os campos de finalização de compra para atender às necessidades da sua loja.
  • Máscaras de entrada: Adiciona máscaras de entrada (pontos e traços) para os campos CPF, CNPJ, CEP e celular para uma melhor experiência do usuário.
  • Compatibilidade com WooCommerce HPOS: Totalmente compatível com o High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) do WooCommerce.
  • Interface administrativa: Interface administrativa moderna e intuitiva para gerenciar as configurações.
  • No seu idioma: Já vem traduzido para o pt-BR, mas você pode mudar qualquer texto que aparece para o usuário.

Este plugin é gratuito e sempre será. Se ele economizar seu tempo, considere me oferecer um café para apoiar o desenvolvimento deste e outros plugins.

External Services

This plugin connects to external APIs to obtain address information based on Brazilian postal codes (CEP), which is needed to autofill address fields during checkout and registration. These services are used only when the user enters a CEP during checkout and the autofill feature is enabled.

BrasilAPI (Primary Service)

The plugin sends the user’s postal code (CEP) to BrasilAPI when the user enters a valid CEP in the address field ‘postcode’.
This service is provided by “BrasilAPI”: https://brasilapi.com.br/docs (terms of use and privacy policy available on their website).

What is it?
BrasilAPI is a free public API that provides Brazilian address data based on postal codes (CEP).

What data is sent?
– Only the CEP (postal code) is sent via a GET request to https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2/{cep} (e.g., https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2/01234567).
– No personal user data (name, email, order details, or IP address) is transmitted.
– Requests are made only when the user enters a valid CEP and triggers the autofill feature (via JavaScript on the frontend).

When is it used?
– When a customer enters a CEP in the billing or shipping address field during checkout.
– Only if the address autofill feature is enabled in the plugin settings (Tab 2: Autofill Addresses).

What data is returned?
– Street name (logradouro)
– Neighborhood (bairro)
– City (cidade)
– State (uf)

Terms and Documentation:
– BrasilAPI Terms of Service: https://brasilapi.com.br/#termos-de-uso
– BrasilAPI Documentation: https://brasilapi.com.br/docs

ViaCEP (Fallback Service)

If BrasilAPI does not return a usable address (network error, HTTP error, invalid JSON, or CEP not found), the plugin tries ViaCEP once as a secondary source.

The plugin sends only the same Brazilian postal code (CEP) in a GET request to https://viacep.com.br/ws/{cep}/json/ (see ViaCEP). ViaCEP is a widely used public CEP lookup service in Brazil. Formal terms of use are not published as clearly as some larger APIs; the plugin documents this connection here for transparency and WordPress.org compliance.

What data is sent?
– Only the CEP digits in the URL path (same scope as BrasilAPI).
– No personal user data (name, email, order details, or IP address) is transmitted by the plugin.

When is it used?
– Only after BrasilAPI fails or returns no valid address for that CEP.
– Only when autofill is enabled and the customer triggers a CEP lookup as described above.

Data Handling

  • No data storage: The plugin does not store or track any data beyond the single request to the API.
  • Optional feature: The address autofill integration is optional and can be disabled in the plugin settings (Tab 2: Autofill Addresses).
  • Fallback mechanism: The plugin tries BrasilAPI first, then ViaCEP. If neither service returns a valid address, the checkout continues with manual entry without fatal errors.
  • User control: Users can disable the autofill feature at any time through the plugin settings.

Data Transmission

Data sent: Only the Brazilian postal code (CEP) entered by the user.
When: Every time a user enters or modifies a CEP field (postcode) during WooCommerce checkout or My Account registration.
Conditions: Only when the user manually enters a CEP value. No data is sent if the field is left empty.
Purpose: To automatically populate address fields (street, neighborhood, city, state) based on the provided CEP.
Storage: The CEP and returned address data are stored locally in the user’s browser session and WooCommerce order/customer data. Responses come from BrasilAPI when available, otherwise from ViaCEP; third-party APIs do not retain that payload beyond normal HTTP handling.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See the GNU General Public License for more details.

plugins.name: BG Couriers for WooCommerce
plugins.author: Dan
plugins.short_description: Bulgarian courier shipping for WooCommerce: Speedy, Econt, BOX NOW, Pigeon, Sameday, Express One, Evropat - office, address, locker, live rates.
plugins.description:
BG Couriers is shipping with Bulgaria’s own couriers inside WooCommerce: your customer chooses where the parcel goes and sees what that delivery costs, and you print the label and follow the parcel without leaving WordPress.

At the checkout every courier you switch on shows its own price for the basket, live from that courier’s API. Your customer picks how the parcel is delivered (to an office, to an address, or to a locker/APS) and finds the office by typing the town, or by pointing at it on one map that carries every courier’s offices and lockers at once, each with its own price. The map can also say which pickup point is closest to them.

In the admin one click issues the waybill and the label: one order, or fifty of them into a single PDF (A6 labels or an A4 sheet). The plugin then keeps each shipment’s status up to date by itself, and your customer sees the waybill and a tracking link on their order and in the e-mails you already send them.

It is free, GPL, and stays that way: every courier, every feature, no paid tier. Deliveries are within Bulgaria.

На български: доставка с куриер за WooCommerce: Спиди, Еконт, BOX NOW, Sameday (easyBox), Pigeon Express, Express One и Европът. Всички куриери в един плъгин: до офис, до адрес или до автомат, наложен платеж, товарителници и етикети с едно кликване, проследяване на пратката. Интерфейсът е изцяло на български.

Couriers

  • Speedy (Спиди): office / address / APS. Live rates, labels, tracking.
  • Econt (Еконт): office / address / Econtomat. Live rates, labels, tracking, and cash on delivery (наложен платеж) with an itemised packing list.
  • Pigeon Express: office / address / locker. Live rates, labels, tracking.
  • Sameday: office / address / easyBox. Live rates, labels, tracking.
  • BOX NOW (BoxNow): lockers (APM) only, picked by town and locker like every other courier (the towns are read off its lockers). Flat rate.
  • Express One: office / address / EXOBOX locker. Live rates, labels, tracking. The address is chosen from Express One’s own street list, which is what its waybills require.
  • Европът (Evropat): office / address. Live rates, labels, tracking. The address is chosen from Европът’s own street list, which its waybills require.

Setting it up

You need your own account with each courier you want to offer: the prices your customers see and the labels you print are your own contract’s, and nothing is resold through this plugin. Once you have the API credentials, a courier takes a couple of minutes:

  1. Paste the credentials on that courier’s tab and switch the courier on; it checks them with the courier there and then, and says so plainly if they are refused.
  2. Sync its towns and offices: one button.
  3. Add it to your Bulgaria shipping zone, and to the zone of any other country you deliver to.

Everything else already has a working default: the prices, the map, the checkout fields and the label size all work as they ship.

Also included

  • Cash on delivery (наложен платеж), with the choice of who pays the delivery, and the amount to collect follows that choice.
  • Free-shipping thresholds, per courier and per delivery type.
  • Several parcels in one shipment, and insurance for a value you set (Speedy, Sameday).
  • A delivery estimate on the cart page, before the customer reaches the checkout.
  • Labels issued automatically when an order reaches a status you choose, or per courier, or not at all.
  • Works on both the classic and the block checkout.
  • Fully translated to Bulgarian.

External services

The plugin uses the online API of each courier you enable, to price a delivery, to create a label and to track a parcel. Nothing is sent to a courier you have not configured.

What is sent, and when

  • Price quote (cart / checkout): the parcel weight, the destination town or office, and the delivery type. When the customer views the shipping options.
  • Label (admin): the recipient’s name, phone, e-mail, the chosen address or office/locker, the parcel weight, and, with cash on delivery, the amount to collect and the item list. When you generate the label.
  • Tracking: the waybill number. When tracking is opened or refreshed.

Courier APIs

  • Speedy: api.speedy.bg. Terms · Privacy
  • Econt: ee.econt.com. Terms · Privacy
  • Pigeon Express: api.pigeonexpress.com (api-demo.pigeonexpress.com in test mode). Terms · Privacy
  • Sameday: api.sameday.bg (sameday-api-bg.demo.zitec.com in test mode). Terms · Privacy
  • Express One: system.expressone.bg. Terms · Privacy
  • BOX NOW: api-production.boxnow.bg (api-stage.boxnow.bg in test mode). Terms · Privacy
  • Европът (Evropat): api.evropat.com. Terms · Privacy

Maps and address lookup

  • OpenStreetMap tiles: tile.openstreetmap.org. Map tiles only, loaded when the customer opens a map. Tile policy · Privacy
  • OpenStreetMap Nominatim: nominatim.openstreetmap.org. One set of coordinates, turned into an address or a town name. It happens in two cases only: the customer drops a pin on the address map picker (a setting, off by default), or presses “find me” on the map before naming a town, so the town can be filled in for them. Nominatim policy · Privacy
  • Google Maps Geocoding: maps.googleapis.com. Takes over those same lookups, and only if you set a Google Maps API key in the settings (optional; OpenStreetMap is used if the key is empty or Google does not answer). It receives the coordinates and nothing else. Terms · Privacy

The map’s “closest to you” (on by default, switchable off) works out the distances in the customer’s own browser. Their position is never stored on the site and is forgotten when the page is closed.

No data is sent to any service you have not configured, and the plugin sends nothing to its author.

Contributing

The plugin is developed in the open. Bugs, ideas and pull requests are welcome on GitHub.

plugins.description:
[DUTCH]

Met de Qupra beschikbaarheid plugin kun je eenvoudig een postcodetool voor internetbeschikbaarheid op je website tonen. Bezoekers kunnen met deze tool op basis van hun postcode, huisnummer en eventuele toevoeging zien wat er op hun adres leverbaar is. De beschikbaarheid plugin van Qupra controleert beschikbaarheid op het koper netwerk (DSL), FTTH (Fiber To The Home), FTTO (Fiber To The Office), landelijke glasvezelaanbieders en diverse lokale glasvezelinitiatieven.

In de Qupra beschikbaarheid plugin kun je eenvoudig de kleuren, bedrijfsnaam en bevestigingsmail aanpassen zodat de plugin integreert met de rest van de website.

Daarnaast is het mogelijk om de prijzen van de verschillende verbindingen geheel naar wens aan te passen. Dit betreft zowel de maandelijkse als de eenmalige kosten. Ook kun je bepaalde verbindingen verbergen, zodat deze niet als optie uit de postcodecheck komen.

De Qupra beschikbaarheid plugin is te gebruiken door klanten van Qupra Wholesale of door een betaalde licentie aan te schaffen.

Over Qupra Wholesale

Qupra Wholesale is een onafhankelijke Wholesale aanbieder voor zakelijke internet, telefonie en IT oplossingen. Doordat Qupra Wholesale onafhankelijk is en niet is gebonden aan een eigen platform biedt. Qupra Wholesale biedt veel flexibiliteit en altijd de beste oplossing voor u en uw klanten.

 
[English]

With the Qupra availability plugin, it’s very easy to display an internet availability tool on your website. Visitors can use this tool to search on their zip code and the house number and see what’s available at their address. The availability plugin of Qupra contains the result of the copper network (DSL), FTTH (Fiber To The Home), FTTO (Fiber To The Office), Nation-wide Business Fiber network, and local fiber initiatives.

The Qupra availability plugin can easily be customized by changing the colors, adding a company name, and personalization of the confirmation email so it blends into the website.

The Qupra availability plugin can be used by customers of Qupra Wholesale or with a free or paid license from Qupra.

In addition, it is possible to adjust the prices of the various connections entirely according to your wishes. This concerns both the monthly and the one-off costs. You can also hide certain connections, so that they do not appear as a result from the availability check.

About Qupra Wholesale

Qupra Wholesale is an independent wholesale party for business internet, voice, and IT solutions. Because Qupra Wholesale is independent and not tied to its own platform, Qupra Wholesale offers flexibility and always has the best solution for you and your customers.
